flags.why: This gloss confuses being dazed or lost in thought with being foolish, which is not a separate meaning of ngẩn ngơ ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ng%E1%BA%A9n_ng%C6%A1)).
The clam name is associated mainly with Central Vietnamese usage, especially around Đà Nẵng ([source](https://thanhnien.vn/mat-long-mat-da-voi-chip-chip-185575109.htm)).
This is an ordinary food name in its home region, so rare misrepresents its everyday local use ([source](https://tuoitre.vn/dulichtphcm/an-gi/ngot-thom-vi-chip-chip-mien-trung-c12a7451.html)).
